title: GMA warns vs fake talent recruitment using exec Annette Gozon-Valdes’ name
summary: GMA Network issued a statement alerting the public of unauthorized recruitment activities involving individuals using the name of the network’s Senior Vice President Annette Gozon-Valdes.…

blocks.text: GMA Network issued a statement alerting the public of unauthorized recruitment activities involving individuals using the name of the network’s Senior Vice President Annette Gozon-Valdes. “GMA Network would like to remind the public to be vigilant against individuals posing as Senior Vice President Atty. Annette Gozon-Valdes and conducting unauthorized recruitment activities on various messaging and calling applications,” it said through its social media pages on Monday, Oct. 26. The advisory came after several individuals reportedly received messages on messaging platform Viber from individuals introducing themselves as Gozon-Valdes.
